title: Repeat Buyer Terms on Trade-In Chargeback Installments
content:
**Terms.** A customer who has bought several vehicles from Kestrel pays a reduced installment today on a chargeback shortfall under **Trade-In Agreements**. The number of Kestrel vehicles bought is counted as the vehicle-price charges posted on the customer's Kestrel purchase orders under **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**.

| Vehicle-price charges on the customer's Kestrel purchase orders | Repeat-buyer share |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.8 |
| Exactly 2 | 0.9 |
| Fewer than 2 | One (no reduction) |

The share multiplies today's figure once; today's installment is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A customer with vehicle-price charges on three purchase orders, today's figure $500.00: $500.00 multiplied by 0.8 is $400.00.
- The same customer with two such charges: $450.00.
- A first-time buyer: $500.00.
